description: Deterministic connector healing and full visual re-rendering ($0 compute cost, instant, unlimited). Cleans exact duplicate edges and empty sequence labels, recomputes deterministic orthogonal layout, and returns fresh `spec`, `svg`, `mermaid`, `excalidraw`, and `studioUrl`. Missing steps or branches require source-backed edits to the spec; this tool preserves graph meaning and does not perform semantic verification. Use this tool after making direct structural edits to `VisualSpec` JSON (`nodes` / `edges`), or when a user asks to autofix connectors.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) if not passed via Authorization header.

orientation.description: Optional layout orientation (defaults to topology auto-orientation).

spec.description: The VisualSpec JSON object to deterministically heal and re-render into SVG, Mermaid, and Excalidraw.

swimlane.description: Optional swimlane layout toggle (defaults to automatic swimlanes when 2+ actor groups exist).
